candidates.name: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma

candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis may deserve minority protection due to its rarity and potential for misdiagnosis as a more common condition, such as a benign nasal polyp or other types of lymphoma.

candidates.name: Plasmablastic lymphoma

candidates.why: The presence of genetic alterations involving BCL6, MYC, and IGH, along with the clinical presentation of a nasal mass, suggests a diagnosis of nasal-type extranodal diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
